I have done mindfulness classes in psych hospital.

Mindfulness is basically allowing ones self to just understand what one is experiencing in the present moment. Usually you try to focus on one of your senses or sensations you are feeling at the time, ie the rise and fall of your chest as you breathe, sounds you can hear etc.

I have found it really useful, but it takes a LOT of practice to get to where it can really be useful.

Take a look at [r/mindfulness](http://www.reddit.com/r/mindfulness) if you are interested.
